instruction:
Research task (no code changes outside .relay/tasks/canon-editorial-spreads/). Goal: a reference board of CANONICAL editorial/magazine spread designs that professional juries agree are excellent, for a fashion/culture magazine project.
Find 40-60 real magazine spreads, covers or editorial page designs, prioritising: SPD (Society of Publication Designers) medal/merit winners, TDC (Type Directors Club) communication design winners, ADC (The One Club ADC Annual) editorial winners, D&AD pencils in Magazine & Newspaper Design, European Design Awards editorial, plus widely cited canonical work (e.g. Brodovitch Harper's Bazaar, Fabien Baron Harper's Bazaar 1992-, Carson Ray Gun, Tibor Kalman Colors, Bruce Mau Zone, Fantastic Man, The Gentlewoman, Apartamento, Purple, Self Service, i-D, The Face, Vogue Italia under Sozzani, Pentagram editorial, M/M Paris).
Use web search if it is available to you. For EVERY item give a URL to a page that shows or documents it (award archive entry, publisher page, museum collection, designer portfolio). Never invent a URL; if you are not sure a URL exists, set url to null and verified to false.
Write .relay/tasks/canon-editorial-spreads/canon.json: a JSON list of objects with keys: title, publication, issue_or_year, designer_or_art_director, award (name+year or "canonical"), url, verified (true only if you actually opened the page), why_canonical (one sentence: the design principle it shows, e.g. type scale contrast, white space, grid break, photo crop), familiar_strange (one sentence: what is conventional in it and what one thing is unusual).
Also write .relay/tasks/canon-editorial-spreads/canon.md: the same list as a readable table, grouped by source, then a short paragraph on recurring principles across the set.
Answer in English. Keep the final printed summary under 1500 characters: how many items, how many verified, whether web search was available.
